programs.title: Body Bizarre
programs.desc: In California, conjoined twins Erika and Eva Sandoval undergo a 17-hour surgery; in Mississippi, Wells Middleton battles through his new future after losing both his hands; in Indonesia, Andriadi Putra has over 30 kilograms of tumors on his body.

programs.title: One Day in My Body
programs.desc: Lukas has Parry-Romberg Syndrome, causing half his face to shrink inward; Stefani's rare muscular dystrophy leaves her dependent on her mother but craving independence; Ellie says steroid withdrawal left her with lizard skin and seeks a cure.

programs.title: One Day in My Body
programs.desc: An allergic reaction left Kirtus with vitiligo, alopecia, and bone loss. An upcoming surgery could change his life. Portia's rare skin condition may exist in fewer than 25 people worldwide. Dani lost all four limbs, and now she fights to walk unassisted.

programs.title: One Day in My Body
programs.desc: There are only two foods that won't send Caroline into anaphylaxis; touching almost anything causes Ariana's butterfly skin to blister and tear; Aleazia's cystic hygroma caused his jaw and tongue to swell, permanently freezing his mouth open.

programs.title: The Face Doctors
programs.desc: Peter undergoes surgery to try to rebuild his nose after losing it to cancer; surgeons battle to reattach Jack's jaw after an e-scooter crash.

programs.title: The Bad Foot Clinic
programs.desc: Podiatrist Marion solves the mystery of Jonathan's twisted toes, gets marathon runner Robert's feet fit for his next race and helps a drag queen back into heels.
